name: Shibusawa Toshiyuki
source:
Vocal Range: Medium-Low
Job: Director of VA Agency

A health-enthusiast and clean freak who's the new director of MC's VA agency. His routine includes nagging on MC everyday to become more diligent in his job as he can see MC's potential to grow as a voice actor.
